lead: The options are different prepositions (by, until, within, since) or a fixed phrase. Look at the time word after the blank and at the verb before it.
選項是不同的介系詞（by、until、within、since）或固定片語。看空格後面的時間字，以及前面的動詞。
steps: Read what follows the blank: a point in time, a length of time, or an event.
先看空格後面接什麼：時間點、一段時間，還是事件。
Check the verb: a one-time action points to by; a state that continues points to until.
再看動詞：一次完成的動作用 by；持續的狀態用 until。
If the options are phrases, such as on behalf of or in charge of, match the meaning of the whole sentence.
選項若是片語，例如 on behalf of、in charge of，就用整句的意思來配對。

head: at, on, in with time words
at、on、in 搭配時間
body: at goes with clock times, on with days and dates, in with months, years and seasons. in plus a length of time means 'after that time'.
at 接時刻，on 接日期和星期，in 接月、年、季節。in 加一段時間，表示「……之後」。
ex: The seminar starts at 9 a.m. on Tuesday, May 12.
研討會在五月十二日星期二上午九點開始。
A technician will contact you in two days.
技術人員會在兩天後與您聯絡。

head: by or until
by 還是 until
body: by sets a deadline for an action that happens once. until says how long a state lasts. Ask: is it done once, or does it continue?
by 是一次性動作的期限；until 是狀態持續到什麼時候。先問：這件事做一次就完成，還是會一直持續？
ex: Please submit the form by 5 p.m. on Friday.
請在星期五下午五點前提交表格。
The office will stay closed until January 3.
辦公室將休息到一月三日。

head: within, for, during, since
within、for、during、since 的分別
body: within means inside a period. for takes a length of time, during takes a named event or period, since takes a starting point.
within 表示在一段期間之內。for 接時間長度，during 接事件或時段名稱，since 接起點。
ex: Returns must be made within 30 days of purchase.
退貨必須在購買後三十天內辦理。
The generator ran for three hours during the power cut.
停電期間，發電機運轉了三個小時。
Our store has been open since 2019.
本店自二〇一九年起營業至今。

head: as of, prior to, following, upon
as of、prior to、following、upon 的意思
body: as of gives the date something starts to apply. prior to means before, following means after, and upon means as soon as.
as of 表示自某日起生效。prior to 等於 before，following 等於 after，upon 表示「一……就」。
ex: The new policy takes effect as of July 1.
新政策自七月一日起生效。
Upon arrival, guests receive a welcome packet.
客人一抵達就會收到歡迎資料袋。
Please complete the form prior to your appointment.
請在預約時間之前填好表格。

head: Fixed phrases
固定片語
body: Some options are whole phrases. Read the sentence for its meaning, then choose the phrase that fits. Learn each one as a unit.
有些選項是整個片語。先讀懂句意，再選出符合的片語。每個片語要整個一起記。
ex: Ms. Diaz accepted the award on behalf of the entire department.
Diaz 女士代表整個部門領獎。
The project was completed ahead of schedule.
這個計畫提前完成了。
In response to customer feedback, the shop extended its hours.
為了回應顧客意見，這家店延長了營業時間。

head: Verb + preposition
動詞加介系詞
body: Many verbs take one fixed preposition. The blank may test that link and have nothing to do with time. Learn the verb together with its preposition.
很多動詞固定搭配某個介系詞。空格考的可能是這個搭配，和時間無關。動詞和介系詞要一起記。
ex: The manager attributed the increase to a better ad campaign.
經理把成長歸功於更好的廣告活動。
The new rule prevents staff from working overtime without approval.
新規定禁止員工未經核准加班。
The report blames the delay on a supplier error.
報告把延誤歸咎於供應商的失誤。

pairs.right: Please return the form by Friday.
pairs.wrong: Please return the form until Friday.
why: Returning the form happens once, so it needs a deadline word: by.
交回表格是一次性的動作，要用表示期限的 by。

pairs.right: The meeting lasted for three hours.
pairs.wrong: The meeting lasted during three hours.
why: three hours is a length of time, so use for. during goes with a named event or period, not a number of hours.
three hours 是時間長度，用 for。during 後面接事件或時段名稱，不接幾個小時這種長度。
2019 is a starting point, so use since with the present perfect.
2019 是起點，要用 since，搭配現在完成式。

head: Verb + preposition
動詞加介系詞
items: 把 A 歸因於 B
把 A 怪到 B 頭上

traps: in time means early enough to catch or join something. on time means exactly at the scheduled moment.
in time 表示及時，趕得上。on time 表示準時，不早不晚。
since usually goes with a perfect tense and a starting point (since March). for goes with a length (for six months).
since 通常搭配完成式和起點（since March）。for 搭配長度（for six months）。
upon and on + -ing mean the same: Upon receiving your payment and On receiving your payment both mean 'as soon as we receive it'.
upon 和 on 加 -ing 意思相同：Upon receiving your payment 和 On receiving your payment 都表示一收到款項就……
